title: Japan Through Time | Historic Trails and Timeless Traditions
highlights: Discover Tokyo’s modern marvels, Hiroshima’s solemn history and Osaka’s lively atmosphere as you journey through Japan, known as the Land of the Rising Sun.
Admire the grand Kaminarimon Gate, famed for its massive red lantern, as you visit Sensoji Temple, Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, founded in 628 AD.
Wander through the sacred grounds of Todai-ji Temple and marvel at the massive Nara Buddha statue, one of the largest bronze statues of Buddha in the world.
Enjoy the lively street performances and explore the bustling canal lined with restaurants as you visit Dotonbori, one of the most lively streets in Osaka.
Ride at high speeds of up to 320 km/h as you travel via the Shinkansen Bullet Train, making long-distance journeys between cities remarkably quick and convenient.

know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa along with ID proof at the time of arrival.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
Extra expenses like visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a property of a similar standard.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon your arrival at the airport, you'll be driven to the hotel. After you check in relax for some time. Later, you can explore the city at your own pace. You can visit the beautiful Tsukiji Honganji Temple, famed for its serene ambience or explore Yoyogi Park, a perfect place to unwind and relax. Also, if you want, you can enjoy a traditional Japanese samurai show at Samurai Theater. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Head to the pick-up point, Matsuya Ginza for the Tokyo sightseeing tour. During this day tour, visit Meiji Shrine, followed by a stop at Akihabara and Ueno districts, known for their local food and shopping options. Continue towards Imperial Palace, famed for its historical splendour and Tokyo Tower, offering panoramic city views. Also, explore Senso-ji Temple and the lively Roppongi area. Later, get driven back to Matsuya Ginza. From there, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From Matsuya Ginza with No Lunch

days.title: Day Trip To Mount Fuji & Hakone Region
days.desc: In the morning, head to Shinjuku Love, the pick-up point to board the transfer for Mt. Fuji and Hakone tour. Upon arrival, admire views of Fuji Five Lakes and Mt. Fuji as you ascend to its 5th Station. Next, enjoy the Hakone ropeway ride, which offers panoramic views of Lake Ashi and the volcanic Owakudani Valley. Afterwards, get driven to Odawara Station to take a scenic bullet train ride back to Tokyo. Once you arrive at Tokyo Station, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After checking out, head to Tokyo Station on your own to take the bullet train to Hiroshima. Upon arrival, make your way to the hotel on your own. After you check in, relax for a while. Later, you can explore the city at your leisure. You can stroll through the scenic Shukkeien Garden and admire the beauty of its serene pond and bridges. Alternatively, visit the Hiroshima Castle, famous for its big halls and courtyards. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hiroshima & Miyajima Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Get ready and reach Hiroshima Station, the pick-up point to board the transfer for Miyajima and Hiroshima sightseeing tour. During this exploration, visit the Peace Memorial Park and Museum, along with the iconic Bomb Dome, a tribute to atomic bomb's victims. Next, take the ferry to Miyajima Island to marvel at Itsukushima Shrine and its torii gates, set against a stunning backdrop. Later, get driven back to Hiroshima Station. From there, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Hiroshima and Miyajima Full Day Bus Tour

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, reach Hiroshima Station on your own and take the bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, head to the hotel on your own and check in. After you relax for a while, spend the day at your leisure. You can visit the Osaka Museum of Housing and Living, featuring artefacts from the city's past, or the Osaka Science Museum, known for its engaging science exhibits, among other notable attraction points. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Osaka Museum Of Housing And Living

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto & Nara
days.desc: From your hotel, make your way to Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda to board the transfer for a day trip to Kyoto and Nara. During this tour, explore Kinkakuji Temple, known for its Buddhist architecture. Also, explore Todaiji Temple and the historic Nijo Castle, followed by a stroll through Nara Park. Moreover, explore the Arashiyama District, famed for its food and shopping options. Later, get driven back to Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda. From there, return to the hotel on your own for overnight stay.

items.title: Kyoto and Nara Sightseeing Day Tour From Osaka - From Osaka+Pork Shabu-shabu

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Get ready and head to the starting point, Hotel Hankyu Respire for the Osaka walking tour. During this exploration, admire the views of the city from the Floating Garden Observatory. Next, immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of the Umeda district before visiting the Osaka Castle. Your tour will conclude at Higashi-Umeda Station, from where you can return to the hotel on your own or some more attractions in the city at your own pace. Later, unwind at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, enjoy a day at your leisure. You may explore Den Den Town, famous for its bustling markets and rich anime culture. Alternatively, explore Amemura, known for its trendy shops and cafes. For sweeping city views, ride the Tempozan Giant Ferris Wheel, which offers a panoramic perspective of Osaka’s skyline. Don’t miss wandering through Tenjinbashisuji Shopping Street, Japan's longest shopping arcade. After a day of exploration, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: With a bag full of memories, check out from the hotel. You'll be driven to the airport to board your transfer back home.
